verdict.rationale: Bento's first-party docs describe an official Bento CLI with 50+ commands covering subscribers, CSV import, tags, fields, events, broadcasts, sequences, transactional email and templates. Bento Skills also tells AI agents when to use the CLI, which makes it part of the AI-native workflow. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and documented install/auth details and agent-oriented output formats (e.g., JSON).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: The Bento CLI gives you 50+ commands for managing your entire Bento account. Search subscribers, import from CSV, manage tags and fields, track events and purchases, create broadcasts and sequences, send transactional emails, manage templates, and more.
Bento Skills tells the agent when to use Bento MCP, the CLI, an SDK, or n8n.
Pick the right Bento surface for the job: MCP, CLI, SDK, or n8n.
